currentResult: Hosted generated readonly queued work restored and completed exactly once; clean restart did not replay it. No source repair is required for this accepted boundary.

actualCaptureCoverage.scope: The two declared generated capture processes and their contained descendants. This is not an inventory of all production or still-active prior application instances.

remainingCriterion: Complete exclusion and coordinated capture/replay for every admitted writer and transport in the declared operating topology, including still-active prior instances; then protected custody and same-set fresh operational restoration.

smallestMissingInput.kind: Existing platform/launcher authenticated read-only membership and lifecycle export for the capture interval

Instance or process identity with start identity, activation/termination state and interval

Secret-free Redis endpoint identity, logical database and every admitted producer route

smallestMissingInput.availableInterfaceLimit: Current Railway tools expose service/deployment/config/log reads but no process-list or runtime-exec primitive that supplies this exhaustive admitted-writer export. smallestMissingInput.notRequested: No production restart, deployment, new host, infrastructure purchase, credential disclosure or extra retention standard.

locallyExecutableNow: Preserve and classify the exact new artifact and reuse accepted O19/Redis/rollback evidence. Neither another synthetic fixture nor repackaging the inspection archive can supply the missing authoritative operating membership.
afterInput: Review each declared member against existing exclusion hooks; identify only actual uncovered writers. Use the already authorized isolated recovery infrastructure for one shared full-coverage examination once the declared topology and protected complete dataset are available. Any necessary changed source receives narrow review and exact-tree approval.
custodyBoundary: The available snapshot remains an inspection/generated recovery set, not a complete operational backup. Object-specific retention/version protection, runtime alteration/deletion exclusion, independent authenticated complete-data readback and same-set corruption refusal/full restoration are still required.
